question: Can a real recording go from 'analysed but untrustworthy' to a Song Model the Arrangement Brain may trust, using the platform's own engines and one producer correction?

song.title: רחם נא (owner's own recording, Dropbox Cubase projects folder)

songModelV1_platformAlone.melody: not_available (1,680 full-mix transcription events below the canonical melody threshold)
songModelV1_platformAlone.sections: 7, low_confidence, cut on the 64.8 BPM grid

rhythm.worker: rhythm-tournament-worker (PR-84), multipart /analyze, Modal 303 poll redirect followed
rhythm.consensus: 130.43 BPM, 4/4; the platform's 64.8 is the half level again (same failure family as PR-84/89 recorded)

harmony.worker: harmony-acr-worker (PR-85) modal run ::batch on a 22.05 kHz mono decode, 96 s

key.BTC: C:min dominates (118.6 s) with F:min (92.0 s), G, D#, G:min

corrections.how: placed by the lead from the bar-by-bar roman-numeral layout and the energy curve on the corrected grid

firstArrangementAttempt.generation: ARRANGEMENT_ORCHESTRATOR 1.0, 3 candidates, REFERENCE_PART_COMPOSER_V1; A conservative selected (score 0.74, symbolic 69/100), C/E diversity_rejected
firstArrangementAttempt.palette: drums GROOVE (1,867 notes) + bass + ensemble TRANSITION (24 notes) - no keys, strings or pad; not the brief
firstArrangementAttempt.mixRevision: MUSIC_ENGINE@1.0 audition, -14.18 LUFS, TP -1.0, 0 findings, approved
firstArrangementAttempt.export: FAILED at rendering 25 %: 'Export job lease was lost' - the synchronous render blocked the 30 s heartbeat timer past the 2-minute lease
firstArrangementAttempt.fix: PRODUCTION_JOB_LEASE_MS knob (default unchanged); the proper fix is an off-thread export render (as PR-72 did for listening renders) - not done here

honestLimits: The chord sheet is BTC's reading, not a human's: 0.786 root accuracy on synthetic audio (PR-85); the lead did not verify the 92 chords by ear.
Sections were placed by the lead from chord/energy structure - a musical judgement, not a measurement; no structure provider is live.
Melody remains not_available: the Brain arranges the harmony and form, not around the sung line.

trusted_automatically here means 'every field confirmed by a producer', which is exactly what happened; it does not mean the analysis was right on its own - v1 was wrong on tempo (half) and contested on key.
